maddeler.e:
أندمل (form VII)
# أَنْدَمِلُ (ʔandamilu) /ʔan.da.mi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
# أَنْدَمِلَ (ʔandamila) /ʔan.da.mi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
# أَنْدَمِلْ (ʔandamil) /ʔan.da.mil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
